scope.summary: Static PL/SQL tools (dispatch_static) validate every advertised string-enum argument against the registry's own input schema before the handler runs, so oracle_plsql_lineage (and what_breaks, sast, doc) refuse an out-of-enum value with INVALID_ARGUMENTS instead of executing.
out_of_scope: Live PL/SQL tools (oracle_plsql_blast_radius, oracle_plsql_live_snapshot, oracle_lineage) go through dispatch_live; blast_radius still refuses a wrong mode via parse_predict_mode, but also accepts hyphen/case variants outside the advertised enum.
W4 driver --case selection of generated contract cases (regressed by 0d9d506d; see limitations).
